messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — I pushed a short spike for a pattern I called 'encapsulation leash'. The idea: when a surface is noisy (rapid schema churn, experimental flags), we add a tiny adapter facade that 1) narrows public contract, 2) centralizes compatibility logic, 3) exposes a clear retirement path. Link: https://rwd.internal/spikes/encap-leash
ben: Interesting. Can you sketch the minimal interface? I worry about doubling codepaths.
olivia: Minimal is 3 calls: open(), route_meta(), and respond(). Each adapter is ~40–80 LOC, all tests mocked. Key is we keep the runtime-facing contract stable; adapters swallow churn.
mai: How does this differ from a sidecar or an enrichment service? Sounds similar but smaller surface.
olivia: Good call — it's basically a micro-facade co-located in the same service process (not a sidecar). No network hop. Goal is containment + easy revert.
zach: Love the containment idea. Operationally: how do we measure value vs tech debt? Need metrics.
olivia: Proposed metrics: adapter churn rate (weekly edits), rollout rollbacks, cross-team incidents tied to surface changes, and delta in downstream deploys blocked by schema changes.
ryan: For paydown cadence, I'd suggest a 6mo lifecycle per adapter: T+0 add adapter, T+2m stabilize, T+4m migrate callers to trimmed contract, T+6m remove adapter. Business teams must opt-in for migration window.
ben: Sounds workable. Who owns the adapter? Original surface owner or caller teams?
olivia: Default owner = original surface. If migration requires significant caller work, we assign a shared owner and add a short runbook.
mai: Can we automate discovery? e.g., a small script that lists callsites and flags candidates for adapters when N callers > 3 or churn > X
olivia: Yup — I prototyped a tool that scans call graphs and commits a PR template. infra-bot: deploy-checker: new scan scheduled nightly for /services/* to produce candidate list.
infra-bot: deploy-checker: scheduled job queued (job id: dq-1745123). Results will land in #devex tomorrow AM.
zach: Migration strategy note: do canary on 10% traffic with adapter enabled read-only, validate no diffs, then flip write paths.
ryan: Rollback safepoint: keep old contract tests in CI for 3 months after removal.
olivia: Small PR to follow with RFC summary + necessary lint rule changes to keep adapters thin.
ben: OK — let's do a 2-week pilot on the model-profile surface. Assigning owners: olivia + mai. Please post a checklist in the RFC.
olivia: Will do. I'll add the timeline, template PR, and the metrics dashboard stub. Thanks everyone :rocket:
